newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle brisk at $68, up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle brisk at $68, up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said.
Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher than last week's close.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 49,300 slaughter steers and 22,400 slaughter heifers. 88,300 head confirmed for the week to date including 7 loads or 300 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants and 15,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 67.00-67.50. Two pens mostly Select 2-3 1150-1250 lb. Corrienties and cutting bulls 65.00-66.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs
Wk to Date - 88,300 Week Ago - 85,000 Year Ago - 31,400
